description: List the batch runs in your workspace across every batch, newest first: each has an id, batchId, status (pending, running, completed, failed or partial), a summary (total, pending, running, passed, failed, error), the test run ids it started, times, and triggeredBy (manual, schedule with its scheduleId, or rerun). Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks how batches have been doing. Name a batch with getBatch. For which tests passed or failed in one run use getBatchRun. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listBatchRuns

items.description:
One execution of a `TestBatch` — one `TestRun` per `testConfigId`. The status
cycles `pending → running → (completed | partial | failed)` based on the aggregate
of the child `TestRun` rows.

summary.description: Roll-up counters for a batch run.

testRunIds.description: TestRun IDs created by this batch (one per `testConfigId`).

triggeredBy.description: `rerun` for a batch run created by `POST /testing/batch-runs/{id}/rerun`.

title: List Batch Runs
